sentences.text: In 2024, the influence index stands at 19.8 for China (band 13.6–49.9, from 3 of six components) and 19.5 for the United States (band 15.3–59.6, from 4 of six components). The two are level.
Over the five years to 2024, the index for China fell by 4.5 points and the index for the United States rose by 16.0 points.

The value for China rests on trade export share, trade import share and diplomatic alignment; every component is a recorded tie (trade shares, finance, debt, UN votes, legislative stance), not a judgement.

The value for the United States rests on trade export share, trade import share, finance flow and diplomatic alignment; every component is a recorded tie (trade shares, finance, debt, UN votes, legislative stance), not a judgement.
In 2025, 0.0% of Paraguay's mineral exports (UN Comtrade value US$0 m) went to China and 0.4% to the United States; together 0.4%, the rest to other destinations.
Since 2020 the share going to China was broadly flat and the share going to the United States fell by 96.2 points.
Relative to the twelve-country export basket, its exports are specialised in rare earths (RCA 9756.6).
AidData records US$68 m of documented commitments from Chinese institutions to Paraguay over 2015–2018 (4 events; the source ends in 2021).
The DFC and OPIC records show US$333 m of documented commitments from US institutions to Paraguay over 2018–2022 (4 events).
Public and publicly guaranteed external debt owed to China was 0.0% of GDP in 2008 (World Bank IDS); no comparable series exists for debt owed to the United States.

The lenders with the largest recorded commitments to named recipients here are OPIC (predecessor of DFC) (US$232 m), US International Development Finance Corporation (US$101 m) and People's Bank of China (PBC) (US$68 m).
In the UN General Assembly, voting agreement in 2024 was 61% with China and 55% with the United States.
Since 2019, agreement with China fell by 22.8 points and agreement with the United States rose by 29.2 points.
Too few mineral-related legislative records naming either actor have been scored for a stance series (five per year are needed); the text model is zero-shot baseline, not yet validated.

After Minerals Security Partnership announced (State Department) (2022-06), the share of exports to the United States moved -67.2 points (97% before, 29% after); placebo p 0.30 against the series' other years (event list still in draft). An association, not a cause.

After Inflation Reduction Act signed (H.R. 5376, 117th Congress): critical-mineral sourcing rules for the clean-vehicle credit (2022-08), the share of exports to the United States moved -67.2 points (97% before, 29% after); placebo p 0.30 against the series' other years (event list still in draft). An association, not a cause.

After Executive Order 13817: A Federal Strategy to Ensure Secure and Reliable Supplies of Critical Minerals (2017-12), the share of exports to the United States moved -51.6 points (100% before, 48% after); placebo p 0.44 against the series' other years (event list still in draft). An association, not a cause.
The published forecast for the influence index of China in 2030 is 19.0 (90% band 0.0–41.8), from naive persistence, because no model beat it in backtests; the last observed year is 2024.

The published forecast for the influence index of the United States in 2030 is 16.6 (90% band 0.0–36.1), from damped local linear trend (Kalman filter, maximum likelihood), which beat naive persistence by 7% CRPS in backtests; the last observed year is 2024.

In 2025, unavailable components: legislative stance (no scored legislative records naming the actor); debt stock (no source for debt owed to the United States); finance flow (source coverage ends 2021); debt stock, diplomatic alignment and finance flow (source coverage ends 2024).

Source coverage ends at different years: Chinese official finance to 2021, US finance to 2024, debt by creditor to 2024, UN votes to 2024 and trade to 2025; components beyond a source's coverage are unavailable, not zero.
12 of the dated events used above are still in the draft event list awaiting the project owner's review.
Stance values come from the text model (zero-shot baseline, not yet validated); the rest of this brief rests on official statistics and the registered databases, each cited on its chart.
